answer: Accounts earn weight only through age-gated reputation: a key's vote counts for nothing until it has stayed active, unflagged, for ninety days, then ramps up slowly. Like a pearl built layer by layer, standing can't be bought at once. An attacker must keep every fake identity alive and behaving for months, so cost scales linearly with heads, and one exposed sock sends a ripple of review over its linked peers, tarnishing that ivory record.
